name: Juggernaut
theme: Apotheosis of the Mountain. 2H stance redirects the world's blows; AoE radius widens; sustains by being unkillable.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'All damage taken reduced by 30% while wielding 2H. Flail sweep cone widens.' (idle-exile reframe per §6.3: offhand-conditional, not weapon-conditional — Class-First compliant.)
Pairs with berserker.json juggernaut path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Mountain + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~26 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Battle Cleave.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 7 of 8 wireable today — clean foundation defensive stats + AoE damage + bleed conditional. Heavy Stance and Mountain capstone offhand-conditional clauses are decorative until Phase F lands offhand-slot-conditional dispatch.

nodes.name: Stalwart
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25 maximum HP (foundation tank-cap for the Mountain).

nodes.name: Heavy Stance
nodes.description: +1/2/3% additional damage reduction (stacks additively with Iron Body — foundation +6% DR cap from this path).

nodes.name: Stagger Sweep
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to Bleeding enemies (Bloodied-target scaler — pairs with Berserker's auto-bleed application via §8.3 baseline).

nodes.name: Iron Aegis
nodes.description: +5% block chance and +10 maximum HP (multi-effect identity — defensive double-investment).

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.description: +10/20/30 maximum HP (deeper tank-cap — stacks with Stalwart).

nodes.name: Mountain
nodes.description: While no offhand is equipped, all damage taken reduced by 30%. AoE/Cleave skill radius +50%. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone (idle-exile §6.3 reframe: offhand-slot-conditional, not weapon-name-conditional — Class-First compliant).
